column1: # Host cases of the base userland (scripts/check-userland.py). Tab-separated:
# ID UTILITY STDIN ARGS. STDIN is a fixture name or "-" (empty). ARGS is split
# with Python's shlex. Each case runs in a fresh directory holding the
# fixtures check-userland.py's FIXTURES defines, with argv[0] = /bin/UTILITY (D-21) and an
# empty environment; userland/expected/ID pins its status, stdout and stderr
# (and every file it created, changed or removed in its directory) as the
# host REFERENCE build (gcc, glibc) produces them. These are the
# guest's expected outputs for T5 except where userland/divergences.tsv
# names the case. Option parsing: every utility has a usage-error case.
